maddeler.e:
استوئر (form X)
# اُسْتُوئِرَ (ustūʔira) /us.tuː.ʔi.ra/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَوْأَرَ (istawʔara) and اِسْتَوْءَرَ (istawʔara)
# اِسْتَوْئِرْ (istawʔir) /is.taw.ʔir/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِسْتَوْأَرَ (istawʔara) and اِسْتَوْءَرَ (istawʔara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
